notes: Captions are drawn only by compositions/captions.html (generated from scene-timing.json). Default plate: bottom-left (kit .cap--left: x 140, bottom 74, width 880) — scene builders keep x 120–1140, y 880–1050 empty. Centred plate (kit .cap--center, bottom 64) in s01 (full-screen hook) and s12 (end card, which has no captions: the disclaimer must have the frame to itself); those scenes keep y 900–1050 empty across the whole width. Camera push-ins keep the phone at x ≥ ~1120, so a pushed phone never sits under a left caption plate. A "\n" in a caption is the intended line break (one plate per line).
